comrades.jaymoskingdoms.thanks.bold.0: I'd have got up anyway. Thanks, %s.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.thanks.bold.1: Back on my feet. Let's finish this.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.thanks.warm.0: Thank you, %s. I thought that was it.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.thanks.warm.1: You came back for me. I won't forget it.
I'd follow you through fire. You know that?
Whatever's out there, we take it together.
I'm glad it was you I came out here with.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.bond.close.stead: You can count on me. Always.
I've made up my mind about you. I'm staying.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.bond.close.quiet: I trust you. I don't say that often.
There you are! I was getting bored.
Now that's a meal worth sitting for.
Thank you for sharing, %s. It's good.
Sit close. Food tastes better together.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.table.meal.stead: A hot meal. Just what was needed.
Thank you, %s. I'll eat and listen.
Right. I know what you want of me now.
Thank you for asking me. It means something.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.bond.cool.0: I thought I meant more to you than that.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.bond.cool.2: I'll keep up. Don't expect more.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.spec.known.1: Read it. Twice. I know it.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.spec.known.2: Keep it for someone who needs it.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.spec.learned.0: So that's how it's done. I'm a %s now.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.spec.learned.2: I read every page. Call me your %s.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.spec.haggle.1: Let me do the talking here.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.spec.haggle.2: We can do better than that.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.spec.overheard.2: They mean to take %s, cover them!
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.spec.forage.1: The land gives if you look. %s for you.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.spec.pack.2: Got it. I'll hold it for you.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.spec.pack.full.2: Sit with me and I'll hand it all back.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.spec.unpack.0: Here, your things. All of it.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.spec.unpack.1: I carried these for you. Take them back.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.land.forest.0: Mind the shadows between the trees.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.land.forest.1: Good wood here. Good cover too, for anyone.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.land.desert.0: Drink while you can. There's little out here.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.land.desert.1: The sand hides more than it shows.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.land.desert.2: Heat like this kills the careless.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.land.swamp.0: Watch your step. The ground lies here.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.land.swamp.1: Something always lives in water this still.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.land.swamp.2: I hate a bog. Let's not stay.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.land.jungle.0: Keep close. You lose people in growth like this.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.land.jungle.2: Listen. It never goes quiet here.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.land.snow.0: Keep moving or the cold gets in.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.land.mountain.1: You can see half the world from up here.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.land.coast.0: Salt on the wind. I like it.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.land.coast.1: Ships come and go along here. Not all friendly.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.land.plains.0: Open ground. We'd see them coming.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.land.plains.1: Nowhere to hide out here. For us or them.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.land.plains.2: Good farmland. Someone will want it.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.land.trap.1: Careful, a wire. Someone set this.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.land.ruin.0: Old stones. Someone lived here once.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.land.ruin.1: Ruins. Things nest in places like this.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.land.ruin.2: Whatever happened here, it wasn't kind.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.town.glad.1: This town's doing well. You can feel it.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.town.glad.2: Good mood in the streets today.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.town.grim.0: Something's wrong here. Look at their faces.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.town.grim.2: Nobody's smiling. Let's find out why.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.quest.way.0: I've done this kind of job before. Head %1$s, about %2$s blocks.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.quest.way.1: Last time I did this, the way was %1$s. %2$s blocks or so.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.quest.way.2: I know this one. Go %1$s, roughly %2$s blocks.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.tip.2: An old hand told me once: %s
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.foe.ours.1: Turn around. This ground is ours.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.foe.ours.2: You're on our land. Walk away while you can.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.foe.headed.1: We know where you're going. We know who sent you.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.foe.headed.2: Tell %s this is as far as you got.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.taunt.broken.1: That armour won't hold another blow.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.taunt.arrow.0: That's your last arrow. Make it count.
You walk into our fire? Bold, %s.
Put the bowls down. We have a guest.
You'd come at us while we eat? Stand up, all of you.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.supper.sick.0: The stew... something's wrong with the stew!
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.supper.caught.0: Hey! What are you putting in the pot?
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.you.hurt.0: You're hurt badly, %s. Rest a moment.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.you.hurt.1: That's a lot of blood. Let's slow down.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.you.hungry.1: Your stomach's louder than mine. Let's eat.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.you.armour.1: That's good kit. Where'd you get it?
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.you.armour.2: Looking sharp. Harder to cut, too.
specialty.jaymoskingdoms.tongue.page.0: Every people speaks its own way, but the bones of speech are shared. Listen for the words that come back again and again: hello, no, food, danger.
specialty.jaymoskingdoms.tongue.page.1: Learn those first, then learn to say them back. A tongue-speaker stands beside a traveller and turns strange talk into plain words.
specialty.jaymoskingdoms.medic.page.0: Kneel low, keep your back to the wall, and work fast. The fallen live or die in the first few breaths.
specialty.jaymoskingdoms.medic.page.1: Pack the wound, bind it tight, and get them up. Twice as fast as anyone untaught, if you've practised.
specialty.jaymoskingdoms.forager.page.0: Every land gives something to the one who looks. Berries in the pines, apples in the woods, mushrooms in the wet.
specialty.jaymoskingdoms.forager.page.1: Walk slowly, look low, and never take the last of anything. The land remembers.
specialty.jaymoskingdoms.haggler.page.0: Never pay the first price. Look bored. Mention the shop down the road.
specialty.jaymoskingdoms.haggler.page.1: A good haggler stands beside the buyer and talks the seller down, and everyone leaves thinking they won.
Pack heavy things low and close to the spine. Strap them tight so they don't shift.
A good packhorse carries what their friend hands them and gives it all back at the fire.
specialty.jaymoskingdoms.quiet.page.0: Step heel to toe. Breathe through your nose. Keep below the skyline.
specialty.jaymoskingdoms.quiet.page.1: When your friend creeps, creep with them. Far off, the enemy loses you in the grass.
specialty.jaymoskingdoms.teach: Give this book to one who follows you (use it on them) and they will learn its ways.
specialty.jaymoskingdoms.give.0: You've been good to me. Take this, it's what my trade taught me.
specialty.jaymoskingdoms.give.1: Here. I wrote down what I know. Maybe one of yours can use it.
specialty.jaymoskingdoms.give.2: A gift, friend. Teach it to someone who walks with you.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.table.title: Sitting down with %s
gui.jaymoskingdoms.table.ask.chatter: Should I talk more, or less?
gui.jaymoskingdoms.table.ask.style: How should I take a win or a rescue?
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.133: Sit by a campfire or at a table with a companion. They'll share your food and ask how you want them to be.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.134: Bands eat at their fire at dusk. Creep up on them, poison the pot, or walk in and face them.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.135: A townsfolk friend may give you their trade's little book. Hand it to a companion to teach them.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.136: Companions you keep close grow fond of you. Leave one lying downed and they'll remember.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.table.sit.0: Mind if I sit with you, %s?
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.table.sit.1: A fire and a rest. I needed this.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.lifting.bold.0: Up on my shoulder, %s! Hold tight!
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.lifting.warm.0: I've got you, %s. Hold on to me.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.errand.1: %s? I know where to find it. I'll have some for you.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.errand.2: Leave it to me. %s, as much as I can carry.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.tavern.0: I'll wait at the tavern. Come for me when you need me.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.tavern.1: Tavern it is. Somebody might want a hand while you're off.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.tavern.2: I'll keep a stool warm. Don't be long.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.wait.0: No tavern here. I'll wait right where I stand.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.wait.1: I'll stay put till you come back.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.work.2: Picked this up on the way: %s.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.part.0: Day's done, %s. Anything I should tell them at home?
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.part.1: That's my day, %s. Any word to send back with me?
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.part.2: Time I went home, %s. Got a word for me?
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.home.1: I was out with %1$s. Their word: I %2$s.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.home.2: %1$s hired me while you were gone. They said I %2$s.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.learned.0: I was out with %s. Learned a thing or two.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.learned.1: Fought beside %s while you were away. I'm the better for it.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.learned.2: %s kept me busy. I've picked up a few tricks.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.back.0: I'm back. I was out with %s.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.back.1: %s hired me for a day. Paid up, too.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.back.2: Did a day's work for %s. Here's your share.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.errand.done: Your errand: %1$s %2$s. Took me a while.
There. %1$s %2$s, gathered while you were out.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.thanks.1: Kind of you, %s. I'll pass it on.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.thanks.2: That'll go down well at home. Thanks, %s.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.hired.0: I'm yours for the day, %1$s. %2$s won't mind.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.hired.1: %2$s lends me out when they're away. Lead on, %1$s.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.loan.hired.2: A day's fighting for you, %1$s. Then it's back to %2$s.
A day's work, %1$s. No fighting, mind. %2$s's orders.
I'll carry and gather for you, %1$s. Fighting's for %2$s.
Work, not war. That's the deal, %1$s.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.taken.ours.0: This one's ours now. Get %s up and to camp.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.taken.ours.1: %s works for us now. Drag them along.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.taken.ransom.2: %2$s and %1$s is yours again. Cheap, really.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.sell.camp.1: Remember me, %s? You had your chance.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.sell.camp.2: You turned me down, %s. They didn't.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.band.boast.0: Did most of it myself, as usual.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.band.boast.1: See that? That's how it's done.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.band.boast.2: Not bad. Not bad at all.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.band.praise.0: Good work, %s. You're getting the best of the spoils.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.band.praise.1: %s, you fought like three of them. Well done.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.band.praise.2: That's what I like to see, %s.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.band.scold.0: %s, did you even swing that thing?
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.way.town.0: I know this way. %s's over there.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.way.town.2: This way. I've been to %s before.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.way.chest.0: There's a chest this way nobody's opened. Follow me.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.way.chest.1: I saw something worth a look out here. This way.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.way.chest.2: Come on, I know where there's a chest.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.way.here.2: Told you I knew the way.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.way.cut.2: They don't know this ground. We do.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.party.done.0: That's the day paid for. Back to the road.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.party.done.1: Contract's up. Good working with you.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.party.done.2: We're square. Find us again if you need us.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.party.warn.0: You picked the wrong party to hit, %s.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.party.won.0: Camp's clear. Let's see what they had.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.party.race.0: This camp's ours, %s. Find your own.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.party.race.1: Back off, %s. We were here first.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.party.greet.0: Looking for swords? The lot of us, %s a day.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.party.greet.1: We're for hire. %s for a day, all of us.
comrades.jaymoskingdoms.party.greet.2: Need a band? %s and we're yours till tomorrow.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.veteran.pitch.1.0: Need a sword that's seen a few fights? %s and I'm yours.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.veteran.pitch.1.1: Twenty years on the road. %s, and I'll keep you alive.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.veteran.pitch.2.0: I served a lord once. Now I serve coin. %s.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.veteran.pitch.2.1: Steel, and the knowing how to use it. %s a contract.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.loan.title: Hire %s
gui.jaymoskingdoms.loan.rating.high: Spoken well of %s times. In demand
gui.jaymoskingdoms.loan.note: A day's hire. The fee goes to their owner.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.loan.part_note: They go home to %s with what you say.
message.jaymoskingdoms.loan.home: %1$s is back: %2$s earned, %3$s gifts, hired out %4$s times
message.jaymoskingdoms.party.hired: %1$s's party of %2$s hired for a day (%3$s)
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.137: A companion left to their own devices may find work. Leave them at a tavern and others can hire them; they come back with coin and stories.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.138: Not every sellsword on the road is a beggar. The old hands cost more, and the ones nobody hires sometimes end up guarding a camp.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.139: A companion who has been somewhere can take you back. Tell them Go while looking that way.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.140: Other parties roam the roads too. Hit one of them and you fight them all. Pay their leader and they're yours for a day.
